```{r}
# =========================================================
# Pokémon evolution dashboard project
# Streamlined analysis script for Quarto/dashboard use
# Story: How does Pokémon type influence strength gain through evolution?
# =========================================================

# -------------------------
# 0. Packages
# -------------------------

library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(cluster)
library(ggrepel)

# -------------------------
# 1. Helper functions
# -------------------------

clean_pokemon_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    str_replace_all("'", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\.", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("-", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "")
}

standard_error <- function(x) {
  sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))
}

# -------------------------
# 2. Read and clean raw data
# -------------------------

pokemon_raw <- read_excel("/Users/kalle/Desktop/Pokemon/pokemon.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names()

evolution_raw <- read_csv("/Users/kalle/Desktop/Pokemon/evolution_long.csv") %>%
  clean_names()

# -------------------------
# 3. Reshape Pokémon table
# One row per Pokémon, with type_1 and type_2
# -------------------------

pokemon <- pokemon_raw %>%
  group_by(number, name, total, hp, attack, defense, special_attack, special_defense, speed) %>%
  mutate(type_slot = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = type_slot,
    values_from = type,
    names_prefix = "type_"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(name_clean = clean_pokemon_name(name))

# -------------------------
# 4. Clean evolution links and join
# -------------------------

evolution_links <- evolution_raw %>%
  transmute(
    evolving_from = clean_pokemon_name(evolving_from),
    evolving_to   = clean_pokemon_name(evolving_to)
  )

pokemon <- pokemon %>%
  left_join(
    evolution_links %>%
      rename(
        name_clean = evolving_from,
        evolves_to = evolving_to
      ),
    by = "name_clean"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    evolution_links %>%
      rename(
        name_clean = evolving_to,
        evolves_from = evolving_from
      ),
    by = "name_clean"
  ) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(name, regex("mega", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(
    evolution_stage = case_when(
      is.na(evolves_from) & !is.na(evolves_to) ~ 1L,
      !is.na(evolves_from) & !is.na(evolves_to) ~ 2L,
      !is.na(evolves_from) & is.na(evolves_to) ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    offense = attack + special_attack,
    defense_total = defense + special_defense
  )

# -------------------------
# 5. Build evolution gain dataset
# Each row = one evolution event
# -------------------------

evolution_gain <- pokemon %>%
  select(
    name, name_clean, evolves_to, type_1,
    evolution_stage, total, offense, defense_total, hp, speed
  ) %>%
  rename(
    from_name = name,
    from_stage = evolution_stage,
    total_base = total,
    offense_base = offense,
    defense_base = defense_total,
    hp_base = hp,
    speed_base = speed
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pokemon %>%
      select(name_clean, name, evolution_stage, total, offense, defense_total, hp, speed) %>%
      rename(
        evolves_to = name_clean,
        to_name = name,
        to_stage = evolution_stage,
        total_next = total,
        offense_next = offense,
        defense_next = defense_total,
        hp_next = hp,
        speed_next = speed
      ),
    by = "evolves_to"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stage_transition = paste0(from_stage, " \u2192 ", to_stage),
    total_gain = total_next - total_base,
    offense_gain = offense_next - offense_base,
    defense_gain = defense_next - defense_base,
    hp_gain = hp_next - hp_base,
    speed_gain = speed_next - speed_base
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_gain))

# Exclude sparse type with only one observation
evolution_gain_main <- evolution_gain %>%
  filter(type_1 != "FLYING") %>%
  mutate(
    type_1 = factor(type_1),
    stage_transition = factor(stage_transition, levels = c("1 → 2", "2 → 3"))
  )

# -------------------------
# 6. Summary tables for dashboard
# -------------------------

gain_by_type <- evolution_gain_main %>%
  group_by(type_1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_total_gain = mean(total_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_total_gain = standard_error(total_gain),
    mean_offense_gain = mean(offense_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_defense_gain = mean(defense_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hp_gain = mean(hp_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_speed_gain = mean(speed_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_total_gain))

gain_by_type_stage <- evolution_gain_main %>%
  group_by(type_1, stage_transition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_total_gain = mean(total_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_total_gain = standard_error(total_gain),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -------------------------
# 7. Optional model check
# Keep for analysis, but not central to dashboard
# -------------------------

model_lm <- lm(total_gain ~ type_1 * stage_transition, data = evolution_gain_main)

# Optional:
# anova(model_lm)
# summary(model_lm)

# -------------------------
# 8. Growth-profile clustering for typology plot
# -------------------------

gain_profile <- gain_by_type_stage %>%
  select(type_1, stage_transition, mean_total_gain) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stage_transition,
    values_from = mean_total_gain
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

clustering_data <- gain_profile %>%
  select(`1 → 2`, `2 → 3`)

clustering_scaled <- scale(clustering_data)

set.seed(123)

silhouette_df <- tibble(
  k = 2:6,
  avg_silhouette = sapply(2:6, function(k) {
    km <- kmeans(clustering_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 50)
    ss <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(clustering_scaled))
    mean(ss[, 3])
  })
)

best_k <- silhouette_df %>%
  slice_max(avg_silhouette, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(k)

set.seed(123)
kmeans_result <- kmeans(clustering_scaled, centers = best_k, nstart = 50)

gain_profile <- gain_profile %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(kmeans_result$cluster))

cluster_summary <- gain_profile %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_early = mean(`1 → 2`),
    mean_late = mean(`2 → 3`),
    diff = mean_early - mean_late,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (best_k == 2) {
  early_cluster <- cluster_summary %>% slice_max(diff, n = 1) %>% pull(cluster)
  late_cluster  <- cluster_summary %>% slice_min(diff, n = 1) %>% pull(cluster)

  cluster_labels <- tibble(
    cluster = factor(c(early_cluster, late_cluster)),
    growth_profile = c("Early bloomer", "Late bloomer")
  )

} else if (best_k == 3) {
  early_cluster <- cluster_summary %>% slice_max(diff, n = 1) %>% pull(cluster)
  late_cluster  <- cluster_summary %>% slice_min(diff, n = 1) %>% pull(cluster)
  balanced_cluster <- cluster_summary %>%
    filter(!(cluster %in% c(early_cluster, late_cluster))) %>%
    pull(cluster)

  cluster_labels <- tibble(
    cluster = factor(c(early_cluster, balanced_cluster, late_cluster)),
    growth_profile = c("Early bloomer", "Balanced", "Late bloomer")
  )

} else {
  cluster_labels <- cluster_summary %>%
    arrange(desc(diff)) %>%
    mutate(growth_profile = paste("Cluster", row_number())) %>%
    select(cluster, growth_profile)
}

gain_profile <- gain_profile %>%
  left_join(cluster_labels, by = "cluster")

# -------------------------
# 9. KPI table for dashboard cards/text
# -------------------------

top_type <- gain_by_type %>%
  slice_max(mean_total_gain, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

dashboard_kpis <- tibble(
  metric = c(
    "Pokémon analyzed",
    "Evolution events",
    "Types analyzed",
    "Top type by average gain"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(pokemon),
    nrow(evolution_gain_main),
    n_distinct(evolution_gain_main$type_1),
    as.character(top_type$type_1)
  )
)

dashboard_kpis

# -------------------------
# 10. Plot theme
# -------------------------

theme_dashboard <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# -------------------------
# 11. Final dashboard plots
# -------------------------

# Plot 1: Overall gain by type
plot_total_gain_by_type <- ggplot(
  gain_by_type,
  aes(x = reorder(type_1, mean_total_gain), y = mean_total_gain)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4C78A8", width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_total_gain - se_total_gain,
      ymax = mean_total_gain + se_total_gain
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    color = "grey25"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average strength gain differs across Pokémon types",
    subtitle = "Mean total-stat gain across evolution steps",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average total-stat gain"
  ) +
  theme_dashboard

plot_total_gain_by_type

# Plot 2: Early vs late gain by type
plot_timing <- ggplot(
  gain_by_type_stage,
  aes(
    x = reorder(type_1, mean_total_gain, FUN = max),
    y = mean_total_gain,
    fill = stage_transition
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Types differ in when they gain strength",
    subtitle = "Comparing early (1 → 2) and late (2 → 3) evolution gains",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average total-stat gain",
    fill = "Evolution step"
  ) +
  theme_dashboard

plot_timing

# Plot 3: Growth-profile typology
plot_typology <- ggplot(
  gain_profile,
  aes(x = `1 → 2`, y = `2 → 3`, color = growth_profile)
) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "grey60"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = type_1),
    size = 3.8,
    box.padding = 0.3,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey75",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pokémon types show distinct growth profiles",
    subtitle = "Above the diagonal = more late gain; below = more early gain",
    x = "Average gain from stage 1 → 2",
    y = "Average gain from stage 2 → 3",
    color = "Growth profile"
  ) +
  theme_dashboard

plot_typology

# Optional methods plot: silhouette scores
plot_silhouette <- ggplot(silhouette_df, aes(x = k, y = avg_silhouette)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "#4C78A8") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#4C78A8") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:6) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster choice by silhouette method",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Average silhouette width"
  ) +
  theme_dashboard

plot_silhouette
```
